en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a large, symmetrical two-story building with a hipped roof and dormer windows. The facade is plastered light color, with many rectangular windows and a central entrance reached by short stairs and a metal gate. A gravel path leads from the foreground up to the gate. Trees or forest are visible in the distant background. In the lower left corner, handwritten-looking text identifies the building.
